description: At turn end, block with standing attention or the command to arm a watcher while work is in flight; allow the stop when a watcher is live. `lobstah hook stop --park` waits in the hook. Each hook runs `lobstah hook <event>`, which detects the session's role (helm, trap, or neither). Inert unless the helm or trap is signed on or the directory opts in. SessionStart announces the session id; SessionEnd stows a soaking session. PostToolUse runs `lobstah hook post-tool-use`: a soaking session's liveness and activity, throttled, inert elsewhere. PermissionRequest runs `lobstah hook permission-request`: a call a person granted (`lobstah grant`, or Allow on a glass card) runs without the prompt; inert for anything not granted and outside traps. The mod in grants.mjs answers Claude Code's tool.check the same way, which auto mode honours.
